info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Partner Authentication API
info.description: The Partner Authentication API facilitates secure access for business partners by enabling them to authenticate their identities within the system. This API allows for the submission of authentication requests, ensuring that only authorized users gain access to protected resources. Typical consumers include B2B partners integrating their systems for seamless interaction. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance security while streamlining the authentication process for their partners.

post.description: This endpoint is used to authenticate partner users by verifying their credentials. Upon successful authentication, a token will be provided for further API requests.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for partner authentication. It requires a valid JSON object that contains the necessary credentials and parameters needed for authenticating the partner's identity.

200.description: Authentication successful and user is logged in.
